FIELDS.NAME: Fairway Gear
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Fairway Gear, we specialize in retailing high-quality golf and sporting equipment, catering to enthusiastic athletes, weekend warriors, and fitness aficionados. Our operations focus solely on the sale of equipment and accessories, ensuring our store maintains a clean, organized, and inviting atmosphere to enhance the shopping experience while prioritizing customer safety through documented safety protocols. Our inventory is updated seasonally to align with customer needs, and we proudly carry brands that uphold our commitment to quality. Safety and compliance are paramount; we are equipped with a professionally monitored alarm system, and we strictly adhere to industry regulations, ensuring an environment free from hazardous materials or unapproved activities. Fairway Gear is dedicated to providing excellent customer service and maintaining a strong financial standing, which allows us to operate smoothly and effectively.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Fairway Sportswear LLC, 456 Greenway Lane, Springfield, IL 62704
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: The store experienced a loss due to water damage from a leaking roof, which occurred on 08/15/2022. The damage was assessed at $1,200.00, and it has been fully resolved with repairs completed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Sunday: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Class 350, Safe Grade B, Burglary and Fire Resistant
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Professionally monitored alarm system with motion sensors and exterior security lighting.

We maintain a safe environment in compliance with industry regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Fairway Gear does not sponsor any athletic teams as our operations are focused solely on retailing golf and sporting equipment without involvement in sponsorship activities.

FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Fairway Gear has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes in connection with this or any other property. The business maintains a solid reputation, focusing solely on the retail sale of golf and sporting equipment.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Fairway Gear has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. The business maintains a solid insurance history and ensures compliance with all relevant requirements.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Fairway Gear does not lease employees to or from other employers, as our operations focus solely on retailing and do not involve employee leasing arrangements.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Fairway Gear currently does not carry Workers' Compensation insurance, but we are exploring options to ensure compliance and employee safety.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Fairway Gear also operates Fairway Sportswear LLC, which is a separate business focused on retailing sports apparel. This allows us to diversify our offerings while maintaining our primary focus on golf and sporting equipment.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Fairway Gear does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. The business currently holds a single policy for its operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Fairway Gear is solely focused on the retail of golf and sporting equipment and does not engage in any manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations are dedicated to providing high-quality retail services without any involvement in production activities.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Fairway Gear does not rent or loan equipment to others as our operations focus solely on the retail of golf and sporting equipment. This policy helps us manage liability risks effectively.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Fairway Gear has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, ensuring a stable financial profile.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Fairway Gear does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on the retail sale of golf and sporting equipment, ensuring a safe shopping environment. We comply with all relevant industry regulations to maintain safety.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Fairway Gear does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are limited to retailing golf and sporting equipment, and we have established safety protocols to mitigate risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Fairway Gear has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong focus on compliance and operational integrity.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are currently no uncorrected fire code violations; Fairway Gear maintains compliance with all fire safety regulations.
